mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2pp in 3 months), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth) signals resilient economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) signals broad-based consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth) signals economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
